page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.large is a virtualized server type within the High Clock Speed family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. It runs on the x86_64 architecture and is driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not bundle local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes for data persistence. It operates without dedicated GPU acceleration and provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. Networking is deployed without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring dedicated network allocation for external access.

Hardware resource allocation delivers high per-core memory capacity paired with elevated base clock speeds. This profile avoids shared-core throttling through dedicated vCPU scheduling, though aggregate network throughput remains bounded at 2 Gbps. The architecture is suited for in-memory caching layers, medium-scale relational databases, and enterprise applications that require dedicated compute cycles with substantial RAM per thread.
